<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex045042026-05-2102-02-19" status="unreviewed">2 pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5552">kha cha'i rtog ge pa chen po bram ze bde byed dga' ba</rs> na re ¦ gnas skabs kyi 'brel pa tshad mas nges kyang spyi 'brel des nges pa mi 'thad de ¦ de ni  yul dus rang bzhin nges pa can la 'jug pas spyi 'dzin pa min <lb n="247"/>
               <lb n="124a1"/> pa'i phyir te ¦ 
               <quote source="db:6569" n="TMK 375a4-5">rang gi mtshan nyid yul can phyir ¦¦ khyab pa mngon gyis yi grub | tshad ma spyir °i rjes dpag ni ¦¦ yul dus spyi la 'jal myi 'thad de || gang° spyi mi yul can ming | de yis khyab pa ji ltar 'grub |</quote> ces rtog ge tho ba lasogs pa bzhin no 
               des na spyi 'brel rang bzhin gyi 'brel pa ni dpyod pas nges dgos zhes gsung ¦
               'o na
               <lb n="124a2"/> de nges byed kyi spyod pi rangin ji lu zhe na de bshad pa la 2e | spyod pi mtshan nyid || rab du dbye ba dang | spyad pa 'jul skye chul | dang po ni 'gal brel gyi rtsa ba la brtens ngar myod pa spyi'i rnaM pa la mtha' pa na du dang po sel byed pa sto | ?did kyis mdzad pa 'brel rtag las | <quote>'jug yul nges pa ma gtogs pa || tshad <lb n="124a3"/> ma'i mtshan nyid med kyang sla || 'brel pa'i rtsa ba la brten nas || rnaM gzhag ° 'gog yis ches rgyu ||</quote><note type="editorial">Verses also cite in RT, ascribed to Lo tsa ba chen pos rnam nges kyi ¥îka las by Glo bo mkhan chen. Is found in dKa' gans p. 257. Also cited by Gro lung pa in bsTan rim chen po, 169a7</note>
               zhes bshad pa ltar ro
               2 pa dbye pa ni sgra la rten pa dang | dngos lo rten pa'i spyod pa'o | dang po ni bar dus su mthong ba'i chad byas kyi 'brel pa brtens pa dang pi don la dogs pa sel ba de || rtsis dang mig mangs kyi
               <lb n="124a4"/>'brel pa ltu'o || yang na chad byas kyi 'brel pa la rtens tha skad kyi dus su shing gi sgra yal 'das med pa la mi 'jug nges pa ltu'o || ra pa la 2 las 'gibang du dngos 'brel pa mthong pa lo rtans de'i ri+en thaMd de 'brel nges pa ste || tshang mang du du ba ma las skye par mthong bas du pa'i ring thaMd me
               <lb n="124a5"/>coM las skye bar nges pa ltu'o || 2 pa ni ngagig du dngoso'i gal pa mthong ba la rten | de'i ri na thaMd 'gal nges po ste || 'dir tsha grang 2 'galar mthong bas yul dus thod du de 2 kyi ring 'galar nges pa ltu'o || 
               2 pa ni | tshad ma lo rtens rtsing po yul du byed pi rtog pa skye las lo rtens zhi
               <lb n="124a6"/>po yul du byed pa'i spyod po skye te | des spyi khya ba dang | spyi 'brel ra po ngar byed ces po | </seg></TEI>
